text: Bitcoin's outpace of Ethereum—2.2% versus 1.7%—combined with rising dominance at 59.7% signals modest risk-on appetite tilted toward large-cap safety. The Fear & Greed index at 63 and climbing suggests cautious optimism rather than euphoria, supported by solid $84B daily volume that indicates genuine participation without froth. Altcoins are following without conviction, which is typical of a consolidation phase where traders are testing resistance but not yet fully rotating into smaller-cap risk.
